verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sach dhaataar hai maanas janam amol dhivaiaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is truly benevolent as he has granted us the human life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ਪੈਰ ਦੇ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mooh akhee nak ka(n)n kar hath pair dhe chalai chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Mouth, eyes, nose, ears He created and has given feet so that the individual could move around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau bhagat upadhes kar naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaiaa|

en.bdb: Preaching loving devotion, the true Guru has bestowed on the people steadfastness in remembering the Lord, ablution and charity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਨਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪੁ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat velai naavanaa gurmukh jap gurma(n)t japaiaa|

en.bdb: In ambrosial hours the gurmukhs undertake to inspire themselves and others to bathe and recite the mantra of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤ ਆਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raat aaratee sohilaa maiaa vich udhaas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: In the evening, instructing the recitation of Arati and Sohild, the true Guru has inspired people to remain detached even amidst maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhei na aap ganaiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru has preached people to speak mildly, to conduct themselves humbly and to not to get noticed even after giving something to others.
This way the true Guru has made all the four ideals (dharma, arch, Wm and moks) of life to follow him.
